title: Decay of the Taylor–Green vortex
shows: A periodic array of vortices decays by viscosity alone: its kinetic energy falls as exp(−4νk²t), ν = (τ − ½)/3 in lattice units, so to 0.2139 of its start after 400 steps.
source: G. I. Taylor and A. E. Green, Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 158 (1937) 499; for the lattice Boltzmann method: T. Krüger et al., The Lattice Boltzmann Method (2017), §5.5.

checks.what: energy left, as a share of the start
